numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across seasons (Season 2 starts at 14), as on Anime Filler Guide and Wikipedia.

arcs.name: Island Arc
arcs.summary: Gabimaru the Hollow, a ninja on death row, is offered a pardon if he can bring back the elixir of life from a mysterious island, watched over by executioner Sagiri Yamada Asaemon.
events: Gabimaru agrees to the mission so he can return to his wife.
The convicts land on Shinsenkyō and find bizarre monsters and flower-covered corpses.
Convicts and executioners start dying fast, and uneasy alliances form.

arcs.name: Lord Tensen Arc
arcs.summary: The survivors learn that the island is ruled by the Tensen, near-immortal beings who draw on a life force called Tao.
events: Gabimaru and Sagiri learn to sense and use Tao.
The group battles the Tensen and learns how their bodies regenerate.
Several groups of survivors join forces as the Tensen fight back.

arcs.name: Lord Tensen Arc: Reinforcements
arcs.summary: A second expedition from the shogunate lands on the island while the surviving teams regroup to face the Tensen.
events: A second party of Yamada Asaemon executioners and Iwagakure ninja arrives on the island.
The survivors and newcomers form an alliance against the Tensen.

arcs.name: Hōrai Arc
arcs.summary: The alliance pushes into Hōrai, the Tensen's palace at the heart of the island, to end the fight and find the elixir.
events: The alliance splits up to take on the Tensen inside Hōrai.
Truths about the elixir and the island's master come to light.
Gabimaru fights to keep his promise to return home.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
